name: Sink or Sin
source:
When Cole Finch wakes up imprisoned with a child and a convict, it's only the start of a descent into a cutthroat life-or-death situation. In Sink or Sin, Twelve people will come together against their will in the good ship Pandora to fight for their lives, to be the last one standing. The twelve left imprisoned down below the depths all share one thing in common: each has a crime they've committed that their horrible host is more than aware of. If someone's crime is exposed to the group, that person will be executed for it. The only way to get clues to the truth is to go through puzzle rooms that may be more fatal than they're worth. With room for only one to make it out alive, the competition is fierce. In order to survive, Cole will have to fight for his life, uncovering the dark truths that everyone finds themselves shackled to. Is there a way to escape the game without leaving alone? Or will sacrifices have to be made?

[From [url=https://djcat-meow.itch.io/sink-or-sin]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当科尔·芬奇 (Cole Finch) 醒来时，发现自己与一名儿童和一名囚犯一起被关押，这只是陷入生死攸关的残酷局面的开始。在《沉沦或罪恶》中，十二个人将违背自己的意愿，在潘多拉号好船中聚集在一起，为自己的生命而战，成为最后的幸存者。被囚禁在深渊之下的十二个人都有一个共同点：每个人都犯下了他们可怕的主人非常清楚的罪行。如果某人的罪行被该团体曝光，该人将被处决。获得真相线索的唯一方法是穿过谜题室，这些谜题室可能比它们的价值更致命。由于只有一个人能活着出去，竞争非常激烈。为了生存，科尔必须为自己的生命而战，揭露每个人都发现自己被束缚的黑暗真相。有没有办法在不离开游戏的情况下逃离游戏？还是必须做出牺牲？

[来自[url=https://djcat-meow.itch.io/sink-or-sin]itch.io[/url]]
